metadata.title: Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Provides visibility, policy enforcement, and risk controls for access to cloud services.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: SaaS, PaaS, cloud identity, API integrations, and cloud access control planes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for mediating and governing access between users, devices, and cloud services.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Access Security Broker defines institutional expectations for visibility, control, and risk management over cloud service usage. This pattern mediates access, monitors activity, and enforces policy across sanctioned and unsanctioned cloud services. It does not replace identity, endpoint, or data protection patterns and relies on them for foundational trust.

components.title: Cloud Service Discovery
components.description: Discovery and classification of cloud services accessed by users and workloads.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid credentials to access unsanctioned or high-risk cloud services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Identification and classification of cloud services in use.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Inventory and classification of cloud services and external system dependencies.
Ongoing monitoring of cloud service usage.

components.title: Cloud Access Policy Enforcement
components.description: Enforcement of access policies for cloud services based on identity, context, and risk.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized access through exposed or misconfigured cloud services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Contextual enforcement of access control decisions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce approved authorizations for cloud service access.
Least privilege applied to cloud access.

components.title: Cloud Activity Monitoring
components.description: Monitoring and analysis of user and workload activity within cloud services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Command-and-control or data exchange over cloud-based application protocols.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Collection and correlation of cloud activity telemetry.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Generate audit records for cloud access and activity.
Monitor cloud activity for indicators of compromise or misuse.

components.title: Data Protection in the Cloud
components.description: Protection of institutional data accessed or stored in cloud services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized exfiltration of data from cloud services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Inspection and enforcement to prevent unauthorized data movement.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protect data through cryptographic mechanisms and policy enforcement.
Cryptographic protection of data in cloud environments.
